h1: Inflatable Photo Booth Hire for Big Groups and Bigger Parties
tagline: A glowing LED-lit inflatable cube for up to ten people, with the colour matched to your theme and a print for everyone inside.
intro: A glowing inflatable cube that lights up the whole room. Our Inflatable Booth holds up to ten people, changes colour to match your theme and prints a copy for every guest inside. If you want a photo booth that doubles as a centrepiece, this is it.

sections.heading: The booth that lights up the room
paragraphs: The Inflatable Booth is a cube roughly 2.5 metres in every direction, inflated on site and lit from inside by LEDs so the whole structure glows. From across a marquee or a hotel ballroom it reads as a light installation; up close it is a spacious enclosed booth with a camera, screen and printer inside.

Guests enter through the doorway, gather in front of the camera and tap the screen. The booth counts down, captures a set of shots, and offers GIFs and filters alongside stills. Prints are produced for each person in the group, and the attendant manages the flow of people in and out so nobody is left outside wondering whose turn it is.

sections.heading: Space requirements: 4m by 4m and two sockets
paragraphs: This is the largest booth we hire, and it needs room to match. Allow a floor area of 4 metres by 4 metres and a ceiling height of at least 3 metres, because the inflated structure stands around 2.5 metres tall and needs clearance above it. Two standard plug sockets are required, and we bring our own extension leads.

Marquees, barns, sports halls and large function rooms all take it comfortably. Village halls and smaller hotel suites often do not, so measure before booking and send us a photo of the room if you are unsure. Ground-floor venues are easiest; the booth travels deflated in bags, but it is bulky, so tell us in advance about stairs, narrow corridors or a long walk from the car park.

sections.heading: Ten people, one photo
paragraphs: Up to ten people can be inside and in shot at the same time, which no other booth we offer can match. That makes it ideal for sports teams, hen parties, extended families and office departments who want one picture with everyone in it. A session takes a little over a minute given the time it takes ten people to get in and arrange themselves, so expect around thirty to thirty-five groups an hour. The glow attracts a crowd, so the booth rarely sits idle, and unlimited sessions mean nobody is turned away.

sections.heading: Prints for everyone, USB and email
paragraphs: Everyone in the shot receives a print on your template, so a group of ten produces ten prints. The guest book gets a copy as well, with space for a message. All images and GIFs are saved digitally, delivered on a USB stick at the end of the hire, and guests can email photos to themselves from the booth during the evening.

sections.heading: Colour matching and branding
paragraphs: The LED glow can be set to a colour that matches your event, whether that is the wedding palette, a company brand colour or a themed birthday. The print template is built around the same colours and carries your names, date or logo, and the welcome page on the screen can show your artwork. Props are included, with themed sets available on request.

sections.heading: Everything included with the Inflatable Booth
paragraphs: The hire includes a professional attendant, free delivery, inflation, setup and pack-down, unlimited sessions, prints for each guest, the guest book, props, LED lighting, the custom template, USB and email sharing, and public liability insurance. There are no hidden extras for the size of the booth or the second socket.

sections.heading: Events it was made for, price and booking
paragraphs: Big guest lists suit it best: large weddings and Asian weddings, corporate summer parties and awards nights, proms and milestone birthdays in a marquee. Anywhere the booth can be seen from across the room, it pulls people in, and the colour change means it never looks out of place against the decor.

Inflatable photo booth hire starts from £299, with an £80 deposit to hold the date and the balance due one month before the event. Availability is confirmed within 24 hours. Our team arrives 45 to 60 minutes before the hire starts to inflate and set up, and that time is not charged. Boothdrop Entertainment is rated 5 stars on Trustpilot; call 07368 631 516 or email info.boothdrop@boothdrop.co.uk.

faqs.q: Can the Inflatable Booth be used outdoors?
faqs.a: Only inside a marquee or a fully covered structure with two standard sockets available. The booth must stay dry and needs a ceiling of at least 3 metres, which most marquees provide. It cannot be set up on open ground or in a gazebo exposed to wind and rain.

faqs.q: Will it fit in our venue?
faqs.a: You need a clear 4 metre by 4 metre floor area and 3 metres of ceiling height. Large function rooms, barns, sports halls and marquees are usually fine; smaller village halls and low-ceilinged hotel suites are often not. Send us the room dimensions or a photo and we will tell you straight away.

Sometimes. The booth travels deflated in bags, so it can be carried up stairs, but it is bulky and takes longer to move than our slim pods. Tell us about stairs, lifts and corridor widths when you book so we can plan the route and setup time.

faqs.q: Can the glow colour change during the event?
faqs.a: Yes. The LED colour is set to match your theme before guests arrive, and the attendant can change it during the hire if you want a different look for the evening party. Let us know your colours in advance so the booth is right from the start.

Yes. Guests can email photos and GIFs to themselves from the booth on the night, and every image is handed over on a USB stick at the end of the hire. The prints for each guest are additional to the digital set, not instead of it.

Where the attendant has no later commitment, extra hours can normally be added at the rate quoted in advance. For big events we recommend booking a longer hire from the outset, because the queue for this booth tends to last the whole night.
